Back to Fallboard Piano

Credits

Scores

  • Chopin’s Ballade No. 1 comes from the ASAP dataset, licensed under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. The interactive notation is reflowed from the dataset edition.
  • Rachmaninoff’s Prelude in C♯ minor and Chopin’s Revolutionary Étude are from PDMX (editions #97837 and #226569), as distributed by Piano: Soloist under CC0 1.0. Prelude source · Étude source
  • Rachmaninoff’s Prelude in G minor uses Joram Berger’s Mutopia edition and the Artform MusicXML conversion. The score and reflowed notation are licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0.
  • Rachmaninoff’s Prelude in B♭ major uses Abel Cheung’s Mutopia edition and the Artform MusicXML conversion. Fallboard restored the cadenza’s beaming, note grouping, and measure numbering. The score and reflowed notation are licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0.

Sound and notation

  • Salamander Grand Piano by Alexander Holm, using the MP3 samples distributed by Tone.js under CC BY 3.0.
  • MuseScore engraving via LibreScore’s webmscore 1.2.1 release and source code, under the GNU GPL. Fallboard serves the bundled data pack under the filename webmscore.lib.pack.wasm.
